title: ProgressionNode
description: Data schema for an individual progression node within a progression tree in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

id.description: Unique identifier for the progression node.

seriesId.description: Identifier of the Series progression tree this node belongs to.

description.description: Detailed description of what unlocking this node grants.

posX.description: X coordinate in UI 2D tree grid spatial layout.

posY.description: Y coordinate in UI 2D tree grid spatial layout.

parentNodeIds.description: Parent node IDs that must be completed before this node becomes accessible.

unlockedFormId.description: Optional Weapon Form ID granted or evolved into upon node completion.

isConvertible.description: True if node is a convertible node whose outcome is resolved in-place upon subsequent milestones.

requirementIds.description: List of requirement IDs that must all be satisfied to unlock this node.

abilityIds.description: List of ability IDs granted when this node is unlocked.

effectIds.description: List of stat modifier effect IDs attached to this node.

recipeIds.description: List of crafting/refinement recipe IDs unlocked by this node.

revealedBranchSeriesIds.description: Optional series IDs revealed/unlocked upon completing this event node.
